description: $0.01 per call (x402, USDC on Base; the first call returns the payment terms, pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). Who holds a public IPv4/IPv6 address, from the Regional Internet Registry RDAP record: network name, handle, CIDR, address range, country, holding organisation, abuse mailbox, RIR (ARIN/RIPE/APNIC/LACNIC/AFRINIC) and reverse DNS (PTR). No geolocation database and no ASN. Cached 24 h. ~0.5-3 s.
